headline: Software slump drags stocks lower
context: Software stocks led a broad sell-off as Anthropic's planned share sale weighed on the sector, while Nvidia's results were due after the close.

winners.name: Comfort Systems USA
winners.why: No company news. It rose against a falling market; fellow builders Quanta and EMCOR were up too.

winners.name: Coherent Corp.
winners.why: Rose after reports that the US will press ahead with limits on imports of Chinese data centre equipment.

winners.name: Ciena
winners.why: No company news. Optical network stocks rose together, with Lumentum also higher.

losers.name: Salesforce
losers.why: Led a renewed software sell-off, its worst day since May 2024, as Anthropic's planned IPO weighed on the sector.

losers.name: Intuit
losers.why: No company news. It fell with other software makers; Salesforce, Workday and FICO all dropped sharply.

losers.name: ServiceNow
losers.why: No company news. It slid with the wider software sell-off led by Salesforce.

sector_note: Median move of stocks in each S&P 500 sector
chart_title: Every sector fell, utilities the most

watch.text: The AI company is expected to start trading on the Nasdaq.

question: Will Nvidia's results be enough to steady the market?
